group: 1. Likelihood and online learning
name: polynomial-width-online-proof
title: Quantitative width and online Bayesian mistakes
status: Quantitative extension of the repository's observed-margin argument.

group: 1. Likelihood and online learning
name: logistic-online-polynomial
title: A smooth-likelihood all-width mistake bound
status: Late-stage draft. Width-scaled guarantee; explicit unscaled obstruction and intermediate kernel limit.

group: 1. Likelihood and online learning
name: sign-only-fourier-counterexample
title: A one-neuron target that defeats wide sign-only Bayes
status: Cosine majority lower bound; ordinary-tanh consequence credits the existing GP theorem.

group: 1. Likelihood and online learning
name: observed-margin-relu-fifteen-errors
title: Observed-margin ReLU mistakes on four and five bits
status: Exact four-bit and five-bit certificates prove 15 and 17 designated mistakes, respectively; no scalable lower-bound family.

group: 2. Bayesian feature learning and prior tails
name: relu-critical-tilt-proof
title: A critical exponential tilt of a Gaussian ReLU neuron
status: Critical local density, scalar-conditioning evidence, independent asymptotic posterior construction in total variation, stable/Gaussian fluctuations, and an explicit sampled-network classification failure. Uses a cited local large-deviation theorem; not individual-label conditioning. An angular-volume criterion explains the endpoint moment thresholds.

group: 2. Bayesian feature learning and prior tails
name: relu-exponential-posterior-condensation
title: Exponentially many exceptional neurons in a Gaussian ReLU posterior
status: Coarse conditioning, energy, kernel, and dimension-asymptotic arguments.

group: 2. Bayesian feature learning and prior tails
name: relu-sharp-condensate-count
title: The exact ReLU condensate count and its polynomial evidence cost
status: Local volume refinement of the preceding posterior argument.

group: 2. Bayesian feature learning and prior tails
name: relu-orientation-law
title: The orientation law of Gaussian ReLU condensates
status: Orientation probability law, exact six-bit combinatorics, and a typical Fourier-concentration theorem using the cited resilient-function enumeration; covariance weights are numerical estimates.

group: 2. Bayesian feature learning and prior tails
name: relu-independent-posterior
title: Independent large-width constructions for Gaussian ReLU posteriors
status: Independent asymptotically exact constructions in total variation for full-cube hard-margin and square/logistic posteriors, with expected O_dimension(width) real-arithmetic cost. No finite-width rate or dimension-uniform guarantee; depends on the exact-count and orientation-law companions.

group: 2. Bayesian feature learning and prior tails
name: relu-iid-feature-learning
title: Width-uniform IID learning and feature amplification for Gaussian ReLU Bayes
status: Late-stage energy and standard margin-bound argument; polynomial data, weaker kernel conclusion.

group: 2. Bayesian feature learning and prior tails
name: relu-parity-feature-transfer
title: Transfer to nearby parity targets after Bayesian feature learning
status: Full-data raw-feature transfer; typical-sector extension uniform in cold positive prior scales, after the width limit. The later low-rank companion separately proves finite-data raw transfer with weaker confidence quantifiers.

group: 2. Bayesian feature learning and prior tails
name: relu-posterior-kernel-fluctuations
title: Kernel fluctuations within a ReLU orientation sector
status: Late-stage conditional CLT. No finite-width moment expansion asserted.

group: 2. Bayesian feature learning and prior tails
name: relu-irrelevant-dimensions
title: Bayesian feature selection among irrelevant inputs
status: Late-stage extension, including Gaussian layer rescaling.

group: 2. Bayesian feature learning and prior tails
name: relu-quartic-posterior
title: Ordinary feature adaptation under faster-than-Gaussian ReLU priors
status: All fixed p > 2; sharp dimension exponents and leading constants.

group: 2. Bayesian feature learning and prior tails
name: relu-heavy-tail-posterior
title: Sparse posterior condensation under heavier-than-Gaussian ReLU priors
status: Finite-domain large deviations and deletion compression for 1 <= p < 2.

group: 2. Bayesian feature learning and prior tails
name: softplus-critical-tilt-proof
title: Gaussian softplus neurons need not have entropy projections
status: Supporting endpoint calculations for the softplus comparison.

group: 2. Bayesian feature learning and prior tails
name: softplus-exact-four-condensates
title: Exactly four softplus condensates
status: Second-order large-deviation selection in the simplest case.

group: 2. Bayesian feature learning and prior tails
name: softplus-likelihood-phase-transition
title: A likelihood-driven condensation transition
status: The factor N in likelihood strength is part of the model.

group: 2. Bayesian feature learning and prior tails
name: softplus-exponential-condensation
title: Exponentially many posterior condensates for a small parity teacher
status: Full even parity; second exponential order selects the count.

group: 2. Bayesian feature learning and prior tails

status: Algorithmic derivations and diagnostics, without a mixing certificate.

status: Fixed-width small-initialization gradient-flow argument; bias-free model.

group: 3. Alignment, trapping, and feature renewal
name: shortcut-renewal-and-imbalance
title: Imbalance and one-neuron renewal at the shortcut trap
status: Descent statements and explicit qualifications of the original trap.

group: 3. Alignment, trapping, and feature renewal
name: partial-recovery-dead-point

status: Explicit local minimum and attracting basin; not a random-initialization theorem.

group: 3. Alignment, trapping, and feature renewal
name: trainable-bias-shortcut-trap
title: A shortcut trap with trainable hidden biases
status: Late-stage construction on a different full-support distribution; conical starts.

group: 4. Adaptive distribution shift
name: adaptive-shift-comparison
title: Tiny adaptive shifts and the importance of a density lower bound
status: Positive comparison and transport of the existing globally conditioned star example.

group: 4. Adaptive distribution shift
name: adaptive-shift-observed-margin
title: Controlled shifts for observed-margin Gaussian ReLU Bayes
status: Energy-cover proof: expectation and high-probability lifetime bounds; positive lower density required.

group: 2. Bayesian feature learning and prior tails
name: near-minimum-energy-transfer
title: Polynomial-data feature transfer for cold Gaussian ReLU Bayes
status: Finite-width actual cold posterior with polynomial IID pretraining and downstream data; exact near-optimal-energy obstruction for unmodified raw features. Selected deterministic Lean proofs; full probabilistic theorem not formalized or independently reviewed.

group: 2. Bayesian feature learning and prior tails
name: heavy-tail-transfer-obstruction
title: Heavy-tail sparsity can obstruct frozen-feature transfer
status: Second-round width-first theorem, dimension-dependent tail exponent; frozen regression, not end-to-end classification.

group: 2. Bayesian feature learning and prior tails
name: square-likelihood-transfer
title: Gaussian square likelihoods can learn transferable parity features
status: Second-round finite posterior theorem with explicit likelihood scaling and ordinary-likelihood corollary.

group: 2. Bayesian feature learning and prior tails
name: transfer-locality
title: Locality of parity transfer in a learned neural representation
status: Second-round finite-width near-versus-distant transfer separation, squared-loss lower bound via trace and symmetry.

name: power-prior-transfer
title: Polynomial-data parity transfer under Gaussian and lighter tails
group: 2. Bayesian feature learning and prior tails
status: Finite posterior transfer for every fixed p >= 2; a narrower continuous bias prior improves sufficient pretraining exponents. Continuous-product initial-feature bound; exact sampling assumed.

name: continuous-initialization-parity
title: Continuous smoothing of parity features: a quantitative initialization threshold
group: 5. Initialization and noisy optimization
status: Second-round result: a universal continuous-smoothing threshold and exact fixed-codimension asymptotics; a same-variance arithmetic initialization contrast, including bias cancellation; specified noisy correlation/hinge dynamics. Same-session checks only.

name: raw-finite-data-transfer
title: Finite-data raw-feature transfer by removing a low-rank component
group: 2. Bayesian feature learning and prior tails
status: Finite-width deterministic average-task bound and finite polynomial-data raw transfer for each fixed nearby task under a permutation-invariant posterior, with an explicit confidence--dimension condition. No simultaneous-all-task guarantee.
